nodes.label: Dual Connection Strings (DATABASE_URL / DATABASE_MIGRATE_URL)
nodes.rationale: The runtime Worker cannot open raw TCP, so it must go through Supabase's transaction pooler (Supavisor, port 6543), but drizzle-kit migrate takes session-level advisory locks that break under transaction pooling, and the direct host is IPv6-only. DATABASE_URL (pooled) serves the deployed Worker; DATABASE_MIGRATE_URL (session-mode pooler, port 5432) serves drizzle-kit and seed/verify. prepare:false is a hard requirement.

nodes.label: Transaction Pooling Semantics
nodes.rationale: Under transaction pooling a transaction pins one pooled connection for its duration - keep statements per transaction small (the intake path is five). Explicit transactions over the transaction-mode pooler were verified live 2026-09-02 (rollback + commit legs PASS). Connection strings contain the database password: gitignored files and Worker secrets only.

nodes.label: Real-Postgres Integration Tests
nodes.rationale: M1's bug class was wrong column names - a Drizzle query against a mistyped column compiles fine and only fails at the database, so a mocked query builder cannot catch it. nodes.label: Fail Loud on Unreachable DB
nodes.rationale: Skipped-when-unreachable suites degrade to a silent green - the exact shape ADR-0003 warns about. Setup pings the db (select 1, short timeout) and fails loud with an actionable message ('Start the compose db: docker compose up -d db'), keeping the suite honest.
